name: unsafe fn increment_strong_count (ptr : * const T)
rule: For safety, if `ptr` was returned by `Arc::into_raw` for an `Arc<U>` and `U` is unsized, its data pointer must have the same size and alignment as `T`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::sync::Arc < T > { unsafe fn increment_strong_count (ptr : * const T) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides neither the `Arc::into_raw` origin and unsized-`U` guard nor `U`’s size and alignment for comparison with `T`.
